g.text: Multi-Slot WOV & ECNS Dual-Stream Pipeline Architecture
wcl-uaol-wov-002: 4-Channel DMIC Capture, 20ms DP ECNS, 2.0s KPB Pre-roll, Concurrent WOV Slots, and Notifier Bus
• NOTIFIER_ID_KPB_CLIENT_EVT: Winning detector commands KPB to drain 2.0s pre-roll buffer to active slot.
• NOTIFIER_ID_WOV_DETECT: Winning detector notifies Arbiter (slot_id) • NOTIFIER_ID_WOV_CTRL: Arbiter broadcasts PAUSE to sibling slots.
